title: Upgrade ObjectQL dependencies to 3.0.1
body:
Upgrades `@objectql/sdk` and `@objectql/types` from 1.9.1 to 3.0.1 to align with latest ObjectQL releases.

## Changes

- **packages/data-objectql**: Updated `@objectql/sdk` and `@objectql/types` to ^3.0.1
- **packages/plugin-object**: Updated `@objectql/sdk` and `@objectql/types` to ^3.0.1

## Compatibility

The 3.0.1 release maintains API compatibility with 1.9.1. No code changes required - all existing ObjectQL data source and plugin functionality continues working unchanged.
